facts.fact: Amnesty International says authorities ordered UNHCR in June 2024 to suspend asylum registrations and refugee status determinations.
UNHCR says 7,812 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered with it as of 30 September 2025 and it renewed 560 registration cards in January 2026.

UNHCR said in a May 2024 report that pre-registration operations in Tunisia had been temporarily suspended, leaving unregistered asylum seekers accumulating, and Nawaat reports asylum seeker cards unissued or unrenewed.
